page.layout: Printed page 428, one text column at full width, with the running head at the top. Below the text: the date line, the letter heading "EPIST. LV.", and its summary line, which is indented. The catchword "Emi-" stands at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: quis daretur exacte ut tuus, & magna cum cura descriptus, quiqve Origenis ae-tate non esset inferior, caeteris paribus, illi potius in rebus dubiis crederem, quam Editioni Romanæ: nec nego, multis in locis illam Editionem ex tuo utiliter corrigi posse, vix enim post Origenem Hexapla ullus Codex omnes ἀπλῶς Aste-riscorum & heterogenearum interpreta-tionum irreptiunculas evasit. Epistolæ modum jamdiu excessi: itaque ne moles-tus tibi sim, scribendi finem facio, sed ne me amandi finem facias plurimum opto. Vale, & me tui observantissi-mum ama.
main_text.head: EPIST. LV.
J. Morinus Cardinali Barberino. Unionem Abbatiæ Juliacensis domui Parisiensi oratorii Postulat.

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred in places. The Greek word ἀπλῶς is read with some doubt and may be a misprint of ἁπλῶς. The æ-ligature in "ae-tate" is hard to read and is copied as "ae". The letter heading and summary are set in larger type and are treated as headings. No printing errors are otherwise suspected.
